newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian cen bank 1997 investment forecast rev down.
newsitem.headline: Belgian cen bank 1997 investment forecast rev down.

text.p: The National Bank of Belgium (NBB) said on Monday it expected investment by Belgian manufacturing companies to rise seven percent in 1997, not 10 percent as previously forecast.
In 1996 manufacturing investments rose five percent.
The central bank surveys manufacturing investments twice a year.

The NBB said in a statement the results of its May 1997 survey showed considerable differences to that done last November, with textile investments being revised up while those in the steel, food and automobile sector were lowered.

"Given the expected moderate evolution in prices, the results indicate that gross capital formation in industry should accelerate slightly in volume terms in 1997 and that company investments will support economic growth in 1997," the central bank said.
The NBB expects Belgian gross domestic product to grow by two percent in 1997.
